elaine (Content): Quick variant for the abstract we didn't try: 'Deploying Inference: cost, latency, and the human signals that matter.' Thoughts?
maria (Marketing Lead): Good. Slightly softer tone. Use as the short blurb on the registration page.
sam (Growth): We'll test registration copy with that blurb vs the more tactical one. Also suggest a secondary line: 'Includes benchmark appendix and decision checklist.'
jordan (Analytics): Reminder: when we publish benchmarks, we need anonymized traces for privacy. I'll sanitize logs and include a reproducibility checklist.
tara (Producer): Update on rehearsals: booked greenroom Tue/Wed 9-12 PT. Please confirm your availability in the calendar invites.
katie (Speaker Ops): Confirmed. I'll add a note: bring a wired headset as backup.
elaine (Content): Draft registration page copy done. I'll push to marketing site branch and ask for a quick review.
maria (Marketing Lead): Thanks, team. Locking narrative: migration rubric + benchmark appendix + clear CTAs. We'll revisit subject lines tomorrow.
